title: Stop Saying "Very Smart"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very smart". Use one of these words instead:
• Brilliant: a brilliant scientist
• Sharp: a sharp mind
• Gifted: a gifted student
• Ingenious: an ingenious idea
• Astute: an astute investor

Which one will you use today? Write it in the comments.
